fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-12-26, a water tank of the complainant near Alli Colony College Road in Vellore was defaced and partly broken. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-12-26 at roughly 23:05. Senthil Prakash approached Vellore Town PS to report the matter and can be reached on 9000000067. The complainant alleged that Gokul Sundaram may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000491. Potentially relevant material referenced includes CCTV footage.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Property reportedly defaced late at night.
fields.Keywords: vandalism, property damage, night, suspect, college road, mobile number, CCTV
